messages:
Maya: quick question — hitting a weird hang in the Go SDK when talking to our private VPC endpoint behind an HTTP proxy. Non-streaming requests are fine, streaming responses stall on reconnect. Using REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private.internal and HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.local:3128. anyone seen proxy vs base_url precedence or streaming buffering oddities?

Kevin: which go-sdk version? we changed transport plumbing in v0.14.x that affected proxy handling.

Maya: Go SDK v0.14.3 (released last week). Auth is metadata-service/token rotation (no explicit API key). Repro is fairly deterministic when client reconnects mid-stream after a transient network blip. Non-streaming retry path works.

Sasha: two quick suspects: 1) proxy is rewriting/preserving Host/SNI and buffering chunked responses, 2) token refresh race producing 401 during reconnect and the streaming goroutine not retrying. For (1) can you curl the same base_url via proxy and compare headers?

Maya: here's the curl I used to sanity-check (from a host in the same VPC):

```bash
curl -v -x http://proxy.local:3128 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Host: private.internal" --http1.1 'https://private.internal/v1/stream?model=small'
```

The curl streaming response comes through fine (chunked), but the SDK stalls only after a reconnect.

Jordan: note: lib/http default ProxyFromEnvironment will route when HTTPS_PROXY is set (and respects NO_PROXY). If your private.internal should bypass the proxy, set NO_PROXY=private.internal or add the CIDR. Otherwise the proxy will see TLS exit if it's an HTTP proxy. That can affect SNI/Host behavior.

Maya: good point — NO_PROXY wasn't set in my env. But in raw curl the proxy path worked. SDK still stalls even when NO_PROXY is set (so it does bypass proxy) — suggests something else.

Kevin: another angle: our SDK streaming uses a dedicated transport with DisableKeepAlives=false and expects connection reuse. Proxies sometimes buffer when they see chunked streaming with intermittent pauses. Try forcing the request to use HTTP/1.1 and adding `Connection: keep-alive` explicitly from the SDK. Also check Transport.Proxy = nil vs ProxyFromEnvironment behavior. Example change we used in internal repro tests:

```go
tr := &http.Transport{
  Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment,
  TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{ServerName: "private.internal"},
  ForceAttemptHTTP2: false, // fallback to http1.1 for proxies that buffer http2 streams
}
client := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 0}
```

Sasha: ForceAttemptHTTP2=false is key for some proxies that buffer/terminate HTTP2. If proxy does HTTP CONNECT & passthrough, http2 might still be negotiated and behave differently.

Linh: on the token race — our token refresher uses a single token value in atomic.Value, but streaming goroutines may see a 401 and not trigger refresh+retry properly. For reconnects we added an intercept that on 401 runs a RefreshToken() and retries once with exponential backoff. Pseudo: 

```go
resp, err := doRequest(req)
if err == nil && resp.StatusCode == 401 {
  refreshTokenBlocking()
  time.Sleep(backoff.Next())
  resp, err = doRequest(req)
}
```

That fixed a similar flake where streams dropped during token rotation.

Maya: thanks, i'll try forcing http1.1 + explicit ServerName + add a 401-refresh retry path. Two quick practical Qs: 1) what's precedence for REDWOOD_BASE_URL vs proxy env? 2) should SDK set Host header explicitly for private endpoints?

Jordan: precedence: SDK will construct request URL from REDWOOD_BASE_URL if present. Proxy envs are orthogonal — ProxyFromEnvironment decides whether the outbound TCP goes through proxy. So both are used: base_url controls target host, proxy env controls route. If you want private.host to bypass proxy, use NO_PROXY.

Sasha: SDK should not rewrite Host by default, but when we swap transports (e.g., TLS ServerName for SNI vs Host header) we set `req.Host = req.URL.Host` in the transport wrapper for private endpoints to ensure Host header matches expected SNI/virtual-hosting. We're going to make this explicit in the docs.

Maya: cool. I'll open a small repro PR showing the hang + curl comparison.

Kevin: action items: I'll add an integration test in our e2e test matrix that exercises (proxy on/off) + private base_url + streaming reconnect. Jordan — can you add NO_PROXY note to the devex guide?

Jordan: yes — I'll update docs and add a short troubleshooting checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled nightly test job "e2e-proxy-vpc-stream" for tomorrow 03:00 UTC :white_check_mark:

Maya: thanks everyone — i'll post the PR and attach logs. :thumbsup:
